title: Visually cluttered anti-pattern
intendedUserGoal: Understand what matters first and avoid being distracted by decoration.

strongFindings.rootCause: Decorative treatments, saturated colour, shadows, and repeated boxes fragment the screen.
Several same-weight actions compete with the primary message.

rootCauseObservations: The important critique is visual maturity and composition, not isolated colour preference.
mergeGuidance: Merge visual noise symptoms into one enterprise polish finding when they share the same cause.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Avoid listing every decorative shadow as a separate issue.
